findings.code_snippet:
res = self.session.post(
    f'{self.API}/channels/{self.channel_id}/messages',
    headers={'Authorization': f'Bot {self.token}', 'User-Agent': self.UA},

findings.reasoning: The code constructs a Discord API URL using self.channel_id and sends an HTTP POST request with an Authorization header containing self.token. If either channel_id or token is influenced by untrusted input, this could leak sensitive data or allow SSRF. There is no evidence of input validation or sanitization for these fields.
